limits: This verdict reviews retained receipts and referenced upstream sources; no fresh model, broker, GPU, recovery or head-to-head comparison was executed.
Private raw logs, account state and hash-bound originals were not accessed; public receipts provide bounded observations rather than independent access to all underlying events.
Historical execution does not establish current host readiness, quota or exact behavior of newer releases.
All adopted candidates' referenced files or relevant sections were accessible. Additional reads of retrieval and lifecycle documentation were bounded to the verdict's scope.
open_gaps: The three selected components have separate native receipts; a single composed SDK worker using both ai-memory and SocratiCode through restart and handoff is not established.
No selected candidate has demonstrated a representative, independently held-out dated financial-source corpus with revision-aware retrieval, historical availability and calibrated abstention.
The twelve-query lexical diagnostic measures a separate QMD lane; its results cannot be attributed to SocratiCode or ai-memory.
Exact source locations were returned in bounded code tasks, but broad source-recovery completeness and semantic retrieval quality remain unqualified.
The disposable memory lifecycle checks establish project routing and ingestion-time behavior, not tenant authorization, market valid-time semantics, secure erasure or off-host recovery.
SDK filesystem restrictions do not remove external MCP mutation authority; full process cancellation and provider spending caps remain separate requirements.
Selected-artifact reductions and cache counters do not establish matched whole-task savings, including failures and retries.
No non-adopted candidate in this packet has retained comparative evidence sufficient to prefer it.

arms: Baseline: native Codex SDK worker with explicitly scoped ai-memory and SocratiCode, retaining exact source reads and all failed-turn usage.
Retrieval challenger: the same worker and frozen task budget with PageIndex or Graphiti replacing only the relevant document or temporal-memory lane.

Orchestration challenger: DeerFlow through codex-acp versus the native SDK on the same bounded evidence-review task, checking actual permissions, output correctness, usage reporting and process cleanup.
overturn_protocol.metric: Compare exact-source recall and citation fidelity, dated-source correctness, abstention, cross-project leakage, restart/handoff recovery, output-contract compliance, actual sandbox permissions, latency and complete returned provider usage. Keep the existing curated retrieval fixture as a regression diagnostic and add independently frozen held-out financial/code questions before claiming general superiority.

overturn_when: Change the verdict after an executed comparison using blueprints/us-equities/retrieval-evaluation/fixture.json and blueprints/us-equities/workers/research-task.md, with lifecycle checks grounded in blueprints/us-equities/memory-lifecycle/run.py, shows a challenger improves source and answer fidelity or complete task cost without degrading project isolation, source recovery, native-client behavior or output compliance. General promotion also requires independently frozen held-out financial/code questions; replaying the existing curated fixture alone is insufficient.
why_selected: Select ai-memory, SocratiCode and the native Codex SDK as complementary defaults spanning the layer's durable-memory, code-retrieval and native-worker scope. evidence/receipts/native-memory.json records actual native Codex and Claude retrieval of the same scoped durable page and receipt of a cross-client handoff. evidence/receipts/native-rag.json records both clients retrieving the correct code path and lines, real local embeddings, and observed automatic add/update/delete propagation; evidence/receipts/desktop-direct-rag.json separately records direct Desktop retrieval. blueprints/us-equities/workers/receipt.json records a completed native SDK research task returning correct receipt facts through focused extraction, while preserving failed file-extraction attempts and their usage. These are bounded native executions, not a measured superiority comparison or acceptance of the combined stack. The project-local worker policy supplies explicit scope and source-reporting rules; dated financial-source retrieval remains an open qualification gap.
